# Haaretz

> > Israel's leading independent newspaper providing in-depth coverage of Israeli politics, the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, economy, and society.

Haaretz is an Israeli news organization founded in 1918, known for its investigative journalism and progressive editorial stance. The publication covers domestic Israeli affairs, Middle East politics, business and economy, culture, and international news with particular focus on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and regional security issues.

## Key Topics

- Israeli-Palestinian conflict
- IDF (Israel Defense Forces)
- West Bank and Gaza
- Israeli politics and Knesset
- Israeli economy and business
- Foreign workers and immigration
- Palestinian Authority and Hamas
- Tel Aviv and Jerusalem
- Opinion columns (Yoel Marcus, Amos Harel)
- Security and terrorism
- Government policy and investment
- Israeli society and culture
- Middle East diplomacy
